messages:
marta (PM): quick sync — we need a tidy list of what blocks us from GA for the customer onboarding rollout (SLA, docs, support handoff, monitoring, pricing). can each owner call out outstanding items?
kevin (Eng): SLA targets: agreed P99 <= 250ms for text gen, error budget defined. outstanding: infra acceptance test for fallback path when a model is down. i can add an automated smoke test, need test spec.
sai (SRE): noted. for monitoring: need route-level latency dashboards + alert when P95 > 180ms for 5m. also require golden prompt evals to catch regressions. i have alert runbook draft but need owners for paging.
julia (Docs): docs items: quickstart update, runbook snippet for common errors, and a public FAQ about pricing tiers. status: quickstart half-done, runbook TODO. ETA for docs: EOW if I get final error codes list.
marta (PM): key dependencies: kevin — test spec by Thu, julia — error codes by Thu, sai — runbook owners by Fri. oliver, any commercial blockers on pricing messaging?
oliver (Sales): pricing side: we need one clear example for Dedicated vs Hosted cost delta + a recommended migration path. legal wants no explicit $ in docs, so we'll keep examples as relative %s. i'll draft a short blurb and a table.
kevin (Eng): code snippet for fallback added to staging branch:```
if (!model.available) {
  routeTo(compatibleVariant)
  incrementMetric('fallback_used')
}
``` need reviews + perf test.
sai (SRE): ops-bot created alert channel #prod-rls-sla. paging policy: oncall alerts after 2 escalations in 15m. need PM signoff.
ops-bot: deploy pipeline report: canary rollout at 10% passed smoke tests; 0 critical errors.
marta (PM): PM signoff on paging policy: yes. also decision: SLA will include a 99.9% availability clause for hosted API only — Dedicated customers get SLA in contract.
julia (Docs): question: do we surface SLA details publicly or behind support?
oliver (Sales): surface high-level SLA table in public docs, link to contract for full terms.
kevin (Eng): rollout plan: canary -> 50% -> 100% over 48h with automated rollback on >0.5% user-visible error increase. add to runbook.
sai (SRE): monitoring checklist: dashboards, golden prompts, error budgets, synthetic traffic, oncall rotation documented. i'll attach checklist to runbook PR.
marta (PM): action items recap: kevin test spec Thu, kevin perf test + PR staging -> review, julia docs updates by Fri, sai runbook owners + checklist Fri, oliver pricing blurb Thu. target GA gating meeting Monday 09:00 PT.
kevin (Eng): one small ask — need a decision on whether quantized model is allowed for Hosted GA (cost tradeoff).
marta (PM): decision deferred to model onboarding thread, but do provide fallback policy now.
julia (Docs): i'll prepare the runbook snippet template and include the fallback code and paging steps.
oliver (Sales): i'll prep the customer-facing blurb and coordinate with legal.
sai (SRE): will add alert thresholds and link synthetic test playbook.
marta (PM): thanks all — if no blockers by Fri EOD we mark this as ready for final GA checklist. ping me on #product if anything slips. :thumbsup:
